meta.note: Expected texts are constructed from the official response_text() section order (Wall time → Process exited with code → Process running with session ID → Original token count → Output: → body, joined by \n) and the official truncation prefix (context_tests.rs:505 asserts 'Warning: truncated output (original token count: 42000)'). DSH counterpart: renderExecResult(value) in tools/exec-command.js. wall_time_seconds renders with 4 decimals (.4). exit_code null (signal death) renders no exit-code section (Option<exit_code>).
